title: Streaming ledger harmonizer and probe harness
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We have recurring discrepancies between recorded token debits and the canonical user-visible transcript when streams are resumed, partially delivered, or involve speculative decoding. Root causes observed in incidents: duplicate crediting on reconnect; missing suffix credits when midstream model-switching occurs; and mismatches between prefix-cached outputs and finalization checkpoints.

Goal: Implement a lightweight ledger harmonizer service and a probe harness to systematically validate end-to-end sessionized metering semantics across streaming life-cycles (create, pause, resume, abort, midstream model handoff, reconnect, and speculative decode). The harmonizer will consume checkpoints and produce reconciled deltas against a canonical session ledger, emitting alerts and corrective proposals (not automatic rollbacks in v1). The probe harness will run fuzz suites and deterministic scenarios to validate token-count invariants and rate-limiter interactions across failure modes.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harmonizer ingests stream checkpoints from production-forwarding topic and produces a reconciled delta report for >= 99.95% of sessions within 30s of final checkpoint. 
2) Probe harness reproduces 90+ deterministic scenarios (including reconnects, partial-fragment resumes, speculative decode rollbacks, and midstream model switch) and detects intentionally injected billing anomalies. 
3) No customer-visible double-charges in the staging replay dataset after harmonizer proposals are manually reviewed. 
4) Dashboard panel (metering-integrity) shows reconciled vs recorded token deltas and a signal for sessions with >1 token discrepancy.
implementation_notes:
- Design a compact session fingerprint: (tenant_id, session_id, start_ts_bucket, sequence_hash) to detect replays and merged session ids.
- Harmonizer will be a stateless consumer with ephemeral local state per-session; reconciliation algorithm uses monotonic checkpoints (prev_offset, final_offset, credit_snapshot).
- Keep reconciliations idempotent: attach a reconciliation_id to proposals.
- Do not perform automated billing rollbacks in v1; emit suggested corrections and a signed audit record for Finance pipeline.
- Use existing gateway checkpoint topic (prod.streaming.checkpoints) and a separate harmonizer topic (prod.streaming.reconciliations) for visibility.
- Add feature flag to enable harmonizer in test accounts and canary tenants only.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for checksum computation and merge heuristics.
- Deterministic integration tests: replay recorded incident traces (3 P0 incidents) and assert harmonizer delta matches hand-annotated ground truth.
- Fuzzing: random frame drops, out-of-order fragments, and duplicate replay injection against the probe harness; ensure rate-limiter neutralization does not double-count.
- Load test: run harmonizer at 2x current checkpoint production rate in staging for 6 hours.
- Manual ops runbook for human review of first 100 reconciliations before any automated corrective actions.
- Add Grafana panels and alerts for reconciliation lag > 30s and for sessions with conflicting credit provenance.
risks_and_mitigation:
- Risk: False positives in reconciliation causing unnecessary customer support churn. Mitigation: conservative heuristics in v1, manual review gate, and backpressure to not emit proposals during peak.
- Risk: Harmonizer becomes a new availability hotspot. Mitigation: consumer autoscaling, stateless per-session design, and retention of only in-flight ephemeral state.
- Risk: Edge-case speculative decoding (partial sampling) misattributed as output tokens. Mitigation: consult sampling-ops team and instrument speculative-flag artifact in checkpoint payloads.
- Risk: Cross-region reconnects with clock skew. Mitigation: use sequence_hash and logical offsets rather than wall-clock timestamps for reconciliation.
progress_updates: 2025-02-20: Ticket created after postmortem of INC-2025-02-18. Identified need for systematic reconciliation service and test harness. Assigned to Mateo.

2025-02-22: Architecture proposal drafted. Chose ephemeral local state approach, will not persist reconciliations to primary billing ledger in v1. Linked design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/METER/Stream+Ledger+Harmonizer

2025-02-24: Spike completed to consume prod.checkpoint topic; validated throughput characteristics and estimated CPU for hashing workload. Spike notes: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1HarmonizerSpike
2025-02-26: Implemented initial checksum and merge heuristic (sequence_hash). Added unit tests. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4721

2025-02-28: Ran deterministic replay of 3 incident traces in staging; harmonizer proposals matched hand annotations for 2/3 traces. Investigating divergence in trace #2 related to speculative decode flag absent in older checkpoints.

2025-03-03: Design review with Billing and Product. Agreed to add signed audit records and to surface proposals via a readonly reconciliation API for Finance. Plan to expand probe harness scenarios and start canary on 5 tenants next week.
notes_for_reviewers:
- Reviewers: focus on reconciliation heuristics and failure modes. Pay attention to sequence_hash collisions and edge-case merging rules.
- Product/Billing: confirm that proposed reconciliation proposal schema has fields needed for Finance ingestion.
- SRE: review autoscaling plan and consumer group partitioning to avoid hot-sharding tenants.
- Security: harmonizer will consume checkpoint payloads containing tenant identifiers; ensure no PII escapes into reconciliation topic.
